show.name: Dead Ahead
show.summary: A high-powered Māori lawyer accidentally unleashes her chaotic tūpuna (ancestors), forcing the living and the dead to navigate their shared legacy.

show.name: Избранный
show.summary: A modest employee of the research institute, Oleg Tyapin, is unexpectedly elected to the Duma of the new convocation. He doesn't want to be a deputy at all, but duty is duty - Tyapin leaves provincial Glebov for Moscow to take on new responsibilities. The hero will go through all the stages of development and formation of himself as a new person, fall in love, and most importantly, experience a lot of comical situations.

show.name: История его служанки
show.summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

show.name: Her Willing Subject
show.summary: Regent Lu Qingcang and Empress Shen Shuying once divided the realm, ruler against ruler—yet the Yin-Yang Gu bound them to a shared fate of life and death. Manipulated by schemers, they perished together. Both reborn, they resume their bitter rivalry. Step by step, through political bloodshed and emotional tug-of-war, they unravel misunderstandings, learn to coexist and love, and join forces to break the game—transforming from hostile rivals into equals in love.

show.name: Summer Vacation
show.summary: Kim Ha Yeon is an ordinary 18-year-old girl who dreams of a life as dramatic as the ones she sees on screen. Her life takes an unexpected, mystical turn when she heads to the unfamiliar countryside village of Upo-ri for her summer break. There, she crosses paths with Jo Yu Gyeom, the heir to a traditional noble family, and his girlfriend, Sae Ryeong. While he possesses stunning looks and a genius talent for swimming, he lives a colorless existence constrained by old-fashioned rules and repetitive routines. As these two opposites meet in the quiet beauty of Upo-ri, their worlds collide, sparking a transformation in their daily lives and the beginning of a once-in-a-lifetime summer.

show.name: Silent Echoes
show.summary: In 2011, a murder case occurs at Jiugu Lake in Xiping City. Detective Ma Xuesong and rookie female officer Meng Wen begin investigating and discover the case is linked to the disappearance of Luo Xue, involving multiple parties including the Deli Group. As more murders surface, a criminal network involving drugs, money laundering, and abuse gradually comes to light. Throughout the investigation, the two draw closer to the truth while each undergoes their own growth and trials.

show.name: Blossom in Darkness
show.summary: The play is adapted based on Guoguo's novel of the same name. Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.

show.name: The Glory Fades
show.summary: Su Yunian infiltrates the glittering, decadent world of "The Heart of Opulence" to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, only to be swept into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng. She soon learns her sister was silenced for possessing crucial evidence. As danger mounts, betrayed by her closest friend, framed by the top courtesan, and relentlessly pursued by Nie Feng, Su Yunian walks a razor's edge between enmity and alliance with Tu Jiasheng. In this realm of illusions, every glimmer hides a blood-stained lie.

show.name: Taming the Husband
show.summary: Jin Bao Zhu, the spirited daughter of a butcher, has always harbored simple, materialistic dreams of wealth and comfort. Desperate to escape her oppressive family life, she volunteers to enter a prestigious canal transport family as the concubine of their son, Xie Yan. However, her dreams of luxury quickly shatter: while Xie Yan was once a brilliant prodigy, he has been left disabled and disgraced by a tragic accident. Xie Yan has become bitter and self-destructive and resents Bao Zhu, who he feels has been forced upon him. The marriage gets off to a rough start, as Xie Yan and Bao Zhu are constantly fighting. But as they navigate the treacherous political schemes surrounding the canal transport industry and fend off ambitious relatives, their mutual animosity slowly transforms. Can they find a way to work together to save their crumbling family legacy and their marriage?

show.name: GuAn
show.summary: In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.

show.name: Phoenix Rising from the Faint Moon
Phoenix Rising from the Faint Moon
show.summary: Feng Weiyue, a modern-day dimensional research team leader, has an accidents during a space experiment and transmigrates to the Yinbei Dynasty together with her colleague Ye Changjiu and her boss Jun Qingye. Feng Weiyue wakes up in the body of the Grand Tutor's legitimate daughter, only to find herself in the bedchamber of the Prince of Rong, Mo Yuya, stuck with the dreadful reputation of a "boy-crazy princess consort". Meanwhile, Mo Yuya is being constantly targeted for assassination by Gu Nanke, the master of the Xingzhao Pavilion. Feng Weiyue unexpectedly discovers that she shares a tangled connection with Gu Nanke, and the dimensional bracelet she brought through time becomes her ultimate cheat code.

body.summary: Gina pushes for the truth, whatever the consequences. Emotions run high as old feelings resurface. Linda's loved ones remain concerned about her wellbeing.

show.name: EastEnders
show.summary:
Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. 

Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

body.name: Episode 11
body.summary: A delivery boss gets a crash alert but can't reach his driver. A roundabout collision leaves a baby crying, and a cyclist's camera captures a terrifying left turn.

show.name: Dashcam Justice
show.summary: Small cameras. Big consequences. From reckless driving to calculated scams, ordinary road users record the evidence that helps police and investigators deliver justice.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: Yi Nian Yong Heng
show.summary:
One will to create oceans. One will to summon the mulberry fields.

One will to slaughter countless devils. One will to eradicate innumerable immortals.

Only my will… is eternal.

A Will Eternal tells the tale of Bai Xiaochun, an endearing but exasperating young man who is driven primarily by his fear of death and desire to live forever, but who deeply values friendship and family.

(Source: Novel Updates)

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: River of No Return
show.summary: Adapted from the novel of the same name written by Ma Boyong, the story follows crown prince Zhu Zhanji, who is trapped in Nanjing and caught in a shocking conspiracy. Together with constable Wu Dingyuan, female doctor Su Jingxi, and junior official Yu Qian, he dodges layers of manhunt and travels all the way back to the capital via the Grand Canal within 15 days to receive the imperial edict.

show.summary: On the Canglan Continent, warriors cultivate their power by communicating with heaven and earth through their martial spirits. Our protagonist, Qin Nan, the young master of the Qin family, accidentally obtains a fragment of the soul of the God of War, a mysterious being from the ancient era. From that moment on, Qin Nan defies his destiny and begins an upward journey. Along his way, he meets beautiful immortal women, defeats celestial geniuses, and becomes invincible in all battles, eventually becoming a supreme and revered Celestial God.

show.name: Still a Family
show.summary: In 2008, with China's economy booming, the Sai Duoxi family living on the Jiaodong Peninsula undergoes a dramatic change. A large demolition compensation payment puts the family's old troubles and chronic problems on full display. Sai Duoxi, a domineering and authoritarian father, throws his children's lives into chaos as he fights to preserve his rule over the household. The five pairs of sons and daughters in the Sai family are five different portraits of life. A sudden turn of events then shakes Sai Duoxi's status as "head of the family," while the five pairs of children begin to reconsider the family's generational relationships and confront their own life dilemmas. Ultimately, the Sai family comes to understand that a home is a place of equality and dignity, and that love means family reunion.

show.name: Jiu Yang Wushen
show.summary: Once betrayed and killed at the peak of his power, Ye Yunfei is reborn into his younger self—the moment his martial veins were first destroyed. With all the memories of his past life, he seizes this second chance to protect his loved ones, outmaneuver rival clans and sects, and rebuild his strength.

body.name: Valencia Floods
body.summary: On October 29th 2024, Valencia is devastated by Spain's deadliest flood. Record heat fuels a rare storm that dumps over a year's worth of rain in a single day, submerging communities and catching residents off guard. Over a million people were affected and at least 230 died. Survivors tell the stories of how their lives changed forever.

show.name: Megastorm
show.summary: Extreme weather events examined from the inside out, including Hurricane Helene, the December Tennessee tornado outbreak and the vicious Black Summer of Australian wildfires, charting how and why they happen and the devastation left behind using first-hand survivor and witness accounts and adrenaline-fuelled footage captured on the ground.

The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.

Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama.

Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.
